### Week starting September 2nd

#### Highlight offers

Starting September 2nd, the Coal and Steel Pack will be available in the shop for a limited time!

Item Atoms Coal and Steel Pack 1,500 Vertiguard Guardian Pack 2,000 Domestic Highlights Pack 1,500 Coalwood C.A.M.P. Kit 900 RoboPaw Steel Dog 800 Floor and Foundations (Coalwood) 500 Settlers Pack Backpack 500 Railroad Water Tower 350 (-30%) Industrial Spotlight 175 (-30%) #### Weekly Deals

This week the Atomic Shop is back with daily offers! Each item is always available until 6:00 p.m. CEST the following day.

*Note: Weekly offers are subject to change.*
